The '''Pirate Confederation''' was an organization that existed during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During that [[Time/Legends|time]], they sought candidates who were willing to test a proposed smuggling route through the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]].
